unitTitle: The Python Hunt - Episode 2: Face-to-face Encounter
scanNote:
2-EPIZOD MAShQLARI (89-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'The Python Hunt - Episode 2'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the pictures on p. 88 and answer the questions.' 1 How does David feel in picture 1? A frightened B tired. 2 What is Adamou holding in his hand in picture 3? A some burning straw B matches. 3 What is Abou waiting to catch in picture 5? A the python's tail B the python's head.
2) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the sentences, then listen to the episode and write D for David, S for Sandra, or A for Abou.' 1 "I wouldn't go back into that hole if you paid me!" ...... 2 "Is Adamou all right?" ...... 3 "Move back, Sandra!" ...... 4 "The snake was lucky today." ......
3) 'Read the episode, then correct the wrong statements.' 1 The python tried to hit David. Ko'k qiya: 'The python tried to BITE David.' 2 Adamou will try to pull the python out by its head. 3 Adamou has never done this before. 4 The python got away because of David. 5 The snake was unlucky today.
4) 'Read the episode again and find two sentences using conditionals type 1, and another two using conditionals type 2.'
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: some - any - no'.
5) 'Complete the table.' JADVAL (sariq): ustunlar things | people | places. some: something | ...... | somewhere. any: ...... | anyone | anywhere. no: nothing | no one | ......

O'NG USTUN:
   OCh KO'K QUTI 'Use': • 'We use SOME and its compounds in positive statements.' To'q sariq qiya: 'There is SOMEONE in the garden.' • 'We use ANY and its compounds in negative sentences and questions.' 'Is there ANYTHING in the fridge? There isn't ANYTHING left.' • 'We use NO and its compounds instead of NOT ANY.' 'There is NO ONE in the room. (= There ISN'T ANYONE in the room.)'
6) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 Do you have ANY/NO money with you? 2 I want to buy my mum SOMETHING/NOTHING special for her birthday. 3 There wasn't NO/ANY milk left in the supermarket. 4 I want to go ANYWHERE/SOMEWHERE exciting for my holidays. 5 Sheila didn't know NO ONE/ANYONE at the party. 6 I need to buy SOME/SOMETHING biscuits for tea. 7 I'm hungry, but there is SOMETHING/NOTHING for me to eat. 8 Julie doesn't go ANYWHERE/SOMEWHERE without her umbrella. 9 There is SOMEONE/ANYONE at the door. 10 NOTHING/NO ONE knows what caused the accident.
7) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode again, then read it out. Next, read the sentences and put them in the correct order. Use them to retell the story.' Kataklar: ☐ David gets into the hole to take pictures. ☐ Adamou pulls the python's tail out of the hole. ☑1 David and Sandra meet the python hunters. ☐ Adamou covers his hand and arm with animal skin. ☐ The python hunters show David and Sandra the holes pythons live in. ☐ Abou pulls David out of the hole. ☐ The snake escapes. ☐ Adamou gets into the hole.
8) 'Read the text and fill in these words:' qiya 'eats, catch, lives, sleep, spends, squeezes'. OQ QUTI, o'ngda qora piton surati: 'Pythons are large snakes. They are found in south-east Asia, Australia and Africa. Some species of pythons can reach a length of 33 feet. The African rock python is found north of the Sahara and is usually about 32 feet long. It 1) ...... in holes under the ground and 2) ...... rats, monkeys and even young antelopes. It isn't poisonous. It 3) ...... the day in its hole and hunts at night. It grabs its prey in its teeth and slowly 4) ...... it with its body until it suffocates. During the dry period, between November and March, the snakes lay their eggs or 5) ...... for winter. They usually lay a hundred or more eggs, which the female python takes care of for two or three months. This is when the python hunters 6) ...... them. It is not a safe job, because pythons are very dangerous when they protect their eggs.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '89'.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (88-bet kadrlaridan):

  1 A frightened - David qo'rqqan
    ('I was just very frightened')
  2 A some burning straw - Adamou
    yonayotgan somon ushlab
  3 A the python's tail - Abou
    ilonning dumini kutmoqda


⚠ 'MATCHES':

  = gugurt (ko'plik).
  ⚠ 'a match' = bir dona gugurt
  (yoki o'yin!).


⚠ 'TO HOLD':

  held - held. = ushlamoq.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

TO'G'RILANGAN GAPLAR:

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode again and find two sentences using conditionals type 1, and another two using conditionals type 2.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni yana o'qing va 1-tur shart gaplari bo'lgan ikki gap va 2-tur shart gaplari bo'lgan yana ikki gap toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR (real - present + will/can):

  • 'If my father IS lucky, the
    burning straw WILL STOP the
    snake from attacking.' (3-kadr)
  • 'Abou CAN'T CATCH it if you
    STAND there!' (5-kadr)


2-TUR (xayoliy - past + would):

  • 'I WOULDN'T GO back into that
    hole if you PAID me!' (2-kadr)
  • 'If he WASN'T all right, we
    WOULD HEAR him shouting!'
    (4-kadr)


⚠ FARQI:

  1-tur: bo'lishi mumkin (otasi
  omadli bo'lishi mumkin).
  2-tur: xayoliy (hech kim pul
  bermaydi; u aslida yaxshi).

points.en: Type 1: If my father is lucky, the burning straw will stop the snake from attacking.
points.uz: 1-tur: Agar otamning omadi kelsa, yonayotgan somon ilonning hujum qilishini to'xtatadi.

points.en: Type 1: Abou can't catch it if you stand there!
points.uz: 1-tur: Sen u yerda tursang, Abou uni tuta olmaydi!

points.en: Type 2: I wouldn't go back into that hole if you paid me!
points.uz: 2-tur: Pul bersangiz ham o'sha inga qaytib kirmasdim!

points.en: Type 2: If he wasn't all right, we would hear him shouting!
points.uz: 2-tur: Agar u yaxshi bo'lmasa, qichqirganini eshitardik!

exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:

         narsa      odam      joy
  some   something  SOMEONE   somewhere
  any    ANYTHING   anyone    anywhere
  no     nothing    no one    NOWHERE


⚠ 'SOMEBODY' = 'SOMEONE',
  'ANYBODY' = 'ANYONE',
  'NOBODY' = 'NO ONE'.


⚠ 'NO ONE' - ikki so'z!
  ('nobody' - bir so'z.)

any - things: ___
no - places: ___

exercises.instructionEn: Use: some / any / no and their compounds
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi: some / any / no va ularning birikmalari
exercises.explanationUz:
SOME - ANY - NO QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME - IJOBIY GAPLARDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'There is SOMEONE in the garden.'
  something, someone, somewhere
  ⚠ Taklif/iltimos savollarida ham:
  'Would you like SOMETHING?'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ANY - INKOR va SAVOLDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'Is there ANYTHING in the
   fridge?'
  'There isn't ANYTHING left.'
  anything, anyone, anywhere


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NO = NOT ANY                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'There is NO ONE in the room.'
  = 'There ISN'T ANYONE in the
     room.'
  nothing, no one, nowhere

  ⚠ IKKI INKOR XATO:
  'There isn't nothing' ✗
  'There isn't anything' ✓
  'There is nothing' ✓


⚠ 'COMPOUNDS':

  = birikmalar (some + thing).


⚠ 'LEFT':

  'There isn't anything LEFT' =
  hech narsa QOLMAGAN.

points.en: We use some and its compounds in positive statements. There is someone in the garden.
points.uz: Some va uning birikmalarini ijobiy gaplarda ishlatamiz. Bog'da kimdir bor.

points.en: We use any and its compounds in negative sentences and questions. Is there anything in the fridge? There isn't anything left.
points.uz: Any va uning birikmalarini inkor gaplar va savollarda ishlatamiz. Muzlatgichda biror narsa bormi? Hech narsa qolmagan.

points.en: We use no and its compounds instead of not any. There is no one in the room. (= There isn't anyone in the room.)
points.uz: No va uning birikmalarini 'not any' o'rnida ishlatamiz. Xonada hech kim yo'q. (= Xonada hech kim yo'q.)
points.noteUz: ⚠ nothing, no one, nowhere - fe'l IJOBIY.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 ANY - savol
  2 SOMETHING - ijobiy
  3 ANY - 'wasn't' (inkor)
  4 SOMEWHERE - ijobiy
  5 ANYONE - "didn't" (inkor)
  6 SOME - 'biscuits' (ot bor)
  7 NOTHING - 'hungry, but' -
    mantiq: yeyishga hech narsa yo'q
  8 ANYWHERE - "doesn't" (inkor)
  9 SOMEONE - ijobiy
  10 NO ONE - odam ('knows')


⚠ 6-BAND: 'SOME' yoki 'SOMETHING'?

  'some biscuits' - otdan OLDIN
  'some'.
  'something' - o'zi ot o'rnida,
  keyin ot kelmaydi.


⚠ 10-BAND: 'NOTHING' yoki 'NO ONE'?

  'knows' - bilish odamga xos →
  'NO ONE knows'.


⚠ 'TO CAUSE':

  = sabab bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'AN UMBRELLA':

  = soyabon.

items.textEn: 1 Do you have any/no money with you?
2 I want to buy my mum something/nothing special for her birthday.
items.uz: 2 Onamga tug'ilgan kuni uchun maxsus biror narsa sotib olmoqchiman.

items.textEn: 3 There wasn't no/any milk left in the supermarket.
4 I want to go anywhere/somewhere exciting for my holidays.
5 Sheila didn't know no one/anyone at the party.
6 I need to buy some/something biscuits for tea.
items.uz: 6 Choy uchun biroz pechenye sotib olishim kerak.

items.textEn: 7 I'm hungry, but there is something/nothing for me to eat.
items.uz: 7 Ochman, lekin yeyishga hech narsa yo'q.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'but' - qarama-qarshilik: och, LEKIN hech narsa yo'q.

items.textEn: 8 Julie doesn't go anywhere/somewhere without her umbrella.
9 There is someone/anyone at the door.
10 Nothing/No one knows what caused the accident.
items.uz: 10 Hech kim baxtsiz hodisaga nima sabab bo'lganini bilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the episode again, then read it out. Next, read the sentences and put them in the correct order. Use them to retell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni yana tinglang, keyin ovoz chiqarib o'qing. So'ngra gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying. Ulardan hikoyani qayta aytib berish uchun foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB (1-2-epizodlar):

  1 David and Sandra meet the
    python hunters. (68-bet, 2-kadr)
  2 The python hunters show David
    and Sandra the holes pythons
    live in. (68-bet, 4-kadr)
  3 Adamou covers his hand and arm
    with animal skin. (68-bet,
    5-kadr)
  4 David gets into the hole to
    take pictures. (68-bet, 6-kadr)
  5 Abou pulls David out of the
    hole. (68-bet, 7-kadr)
  6 Adamou gets into the hole.
    (88-bet, 2-3-kadr)
  7 Adamou pulls the python's tail
    out of the hole. (88-bet,
    5-kadr)
  8 The snake escapes. (88-bet,
    6-7-kadr)


⚠ 'TO RETELL':

  = qayta aytib bermoq.


⚠ 'TO ESCAPE' = 'TO GET AWAY':

  = qochmoq.


⚠ 'TO COVER':

  = qoplamoq, o'ramoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in these words: eats, catch, lives, sleep, spends, squeezes
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va ushbu so'zlarni qo'ying: eats, catch, lives, sleep, spends, squeezes
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Pitonlar - katta ilonlar. Ular
janubi-sharqiy Osiyo, Avstraliya va
Afrikada uchraydi. Pitonlarning
ba'zi turlari 33 fut (10 m)
uzunlikka yetishi mumkin. Afrika tosh
pitoni Sahroi Kabirning shimolida
uchraydi va odatda 32 fut uzunlikda.
U yer ostidagi inlarda YAShAYDI va
kalamush, maymun va hatto yosh
antilopalarni YEYDI. U zaharli emas.
U kunduzni inida O'TKAZADI va
kechasi ov qiladi. U o'ljasini
tishlari bilan ushlaydi va tanasi
bilan asta-sekin SIQADI - to
bo'g'ilguncha. Quruq davrda, noyabr
va mart oralig'ida, ilonlar tuxum
qo'yadi yoki qishki UYQUGA KETADI.
Ular odatda yuz yoki undan ko'p
tuxum qo'yadi, urg'ochi piton ularga
ikki-uch oy g'amxo'rlik qiladi. Aynan
shu vaqtda piton ovchilari ularni
TUTADI. Bu xavfsiz ish emas, chunki
pitonlar tuxumlarini himoya qilganda
juda xavfli.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 lives  2 eats  3 spends
  4 squeezes  5 sleep  6 catch

  ⚠ 'the snakes ... SLEEP' - ko'plik,
  -S yo'q.
  ⚠ 'the python hunters CATCH' -
  ko'plik.


⚠ 'A SPECIES':

  = tur. Birlik = ko'plik.


⚠ 'A FOOT / FEET':

  = fut (30 sm). 33 feet ≈ 10 m.


⚠ 'POISONOUS':

  = zaharli.


⚠ 'PREY':

  = o'lja.


⚠ 'TO SQUEEZE':

  = siqmoq.


⚠ 'TO SUFFOCATE':

  = bo'g'ilmoq.


⚠ 'TO LAY EGGS':

  = tuxum qo'ymoq.
  ⚠ lay - laid - laid.


⚠ 'FEMALE':

  = urg'ochi. 'male' = erkak.


⚠ 'TO TAKE CARE OF':

  = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.
